seed: Objects of type `player` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [wall] show mixed outcomes: x x2, no_change x2. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes: Mirrored 4x4 block pair: actions 1-4 move each block iff its whole destination rect is colour 5 (blocked independently). Click on inactive marker arms players (10->1) and activates it (9->11); click on armed player reverts to blocks and deactivates all markers. Armed mode: arrows move the active 2x2 marker on colour-5 cells; vacated cells restore to 5. HUD colour-0 bars on row 0 (right-anchored) and row 63 (left-anchored), width ceil(3(n-1)/7), n = every action incl. clicks/no-ops, tracked via continuity with bar-width fallback. Unverified: marker direction for x>=32, action 2 in block mode, click on empty cells.
